name: 92253 · La Quinta, CA
findings: ZIP 92253 (La Quinta) has 112 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92253 (La Quinta) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92253 (La Quinta) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
